articles.title: Plan to toughen protections for subsea internet cables amid heightened Russian activity

articles.title: CBSE plans to send answer sheets on DigiLocker along with marksheets from next year
articles.summary: The CBSE board plans to significantly enhance transparency and accessibility for students by making evaluated answer sheets available on DigiLocker from next year. This initiative will allow students to digitally access their answer scripts alongside their mark sheets. This move aims to streamline academic record access, providing a secure and convenient platform for students across the nation, improving the examination process.
